adminCompensation.title: Node compensation
adminCompensation.copy: Review complete X-Node outage observations before extending active members.
adminCompensation.configCopy: New outages snapshot this policy. Existing events keep the values captured when observation began.
adminCompensation.enabledHint: Disabled configuration still allows open observations to recover, but creates no new events.
adminCompensation.loadFailed: Compensation data could not be loaded.
adminCompensation.saveFailed: The configuration could not be saved. Refresh and review its revision.
adminCompensation.reviewFailed: The review could not be saved. Refresh the event or report the request ID to an administrator.
adminCompensation.noneHint: Outages created while observation is configured will appear here.
adminCompensation.reviewCopy: Only the extension and audit reason are editable. The outage, squads, and frozen recipient set cannot change.

reason.below_threshold: Downtime did not strictly exceed the captured threshold.
reason.no_recipients: No active members were frozen for the affected squads.
reason.computed_zero: The captured multiplier computed to zero minutes.
